issues.description: build() calls _fix_launcher_shebangs (called at line 82, defined lines 92-114), which rewrites the '#!' line of launcher scripts inside the ocaml dependency's package folder in the Conan cache by injecting an absolute cache path: line 107 `candidate = os.path.join(ocaml_bin, os.path.basename(parts[0]))` and line 109 `data = ("#!" + candidate).encode() + data[nl:]`. This mutates another package's cached artifacts at build time (breaks Conan cache immutability / later `conan cache verify` and embeds machine-specific absolute paths). It is disclosed in the docstring (lines 15-18, 'Defensive launcher-shebang fix for the ocaml package scripts') and idempotent (line 105 skips when the interpreter path already exists), so this is advisory only.
issues.fix_suggestion: Prefer fixing the launcher shebangs in the ocaml/4.14.1.1.2 package itself or wrapping the launchers from the consuming side instead of mutating a dependency's cache folder; if kept as-is, note explicitly that cache verification of ocaml/4.14.1.1.2 will flag the modified files.
